description: Configuration for TDK Landscape services. Drives Tilt orchestration, Docker Compose generation, and dependency resolution. Supports both explicit service.json files and synthesis from directory structure (CEO Review: rename-service-manifest).

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for IDE validation

apiBasePath.description: Base path for API routes in Traefik.

appType.description:
Service type determining build strategy:
• backend - Hono/Express API server
• frontend - Vite/React application
• sdk - Shared library package
• worker - Background job processor
• migrator - Database migration runner
• library - Shared code library

backendName.description:
For frontends: associated backend service.
Auto-computed from appName if not specified.

basePath.description: Base path for frontend routing on TDK Landscape.localhost. Default is /{stack}s when omitted.

databaseName.description:
Override auto-generated DB name.
Default: TDK_{stack}

dependencies.description:
Resource dependencies used for startup ordering and frontend dependency env generation.
Each entry can be a stack name (e.g. 'user') or resource name (e.g. 'user-management-backend').

dockerfile.description: Custom Dockerfile path relative to service directory.

params.description: Non-secret configuration parameters (BASE_URL, PORT, etc.). Secrets use 'secrets' section below.

secrets.description: Secret references resolved via Infisical. NO secrets in params/envVars - security violation.

required.description: Required secret names. Service CRASHES if any are missing.

optional.description: Optional secret names. Service starts but warns if missing.

features.description:
Platform features:
• nats - NATS JetStream eventing
• prisma - DB ORM & migrations
• redis - Caching layer
• infisical - Secrets management
• vitest - Test framework
• traefik - Reverse proxy routing
• websocket - WS support
• graphql - GraphQL server
• grpc - gRPC protocol

healthCheckPath.description: HTTP endpoint for health checks. Must return 200 OK.

internalDependencies.description:
Legacy alias of dependencies. Domain dependencies for Tilt's dependency graph.
Services listed here start before this service.
Used for focus mode, health checks, migration order.

nats.description: Custom NATS configuration. Auto-generated if 'nats' in features.

queueGroup.description: NATS queue group for load balancing

playwright.description: Generate Playwright config in .autogenerated/playwright.config.autogenerated.ts when true.

port.description:
External dev port (internal always 3000).
Assignments:
• 4000: user
• 4001: service
• 4002: order
• 4003: team
• 4004: auth

replicas.description:
Container instances to run.
Creates separate containers (service-1, service-2).
Traefik load-balances between all replicas.

runtime.description: Runtime to use for this service

syncs.description:
Directories to sync for hot-reload.
Auto-computed if not specified:
• backend: ['src', 'prisma']
• frontend: ['src', 'public']

traefik.description: Custom Traefik routing. Auto-generated if not specified.

title: TDK Landscape Service Configuration
